source: SportsDataverse/hoopR CC BY 4.0 retained team_box and schedule files, season end years 2019 through 2026

population.identityJoin: game date plus effective-dated home/away franchise abbreviation, reconciled to score and provider game_id
population.integrityQuarantineReason: Both retained team rows fail points = 2*FGM + 3PM + FTM although schedule and box final scores agree; raw evidence is preserved and no component statistic is inferred.

roles.qualification: Every season has been inspected previously for Gen1; none is described as a fresh untouched holdout. Candidate choice is frozen before scoring.

configurations.features: exact Gen1 78 numerical features plus frozen prior-game team-box contract
configurations.chronology: season-forward fitting; train-only imputer, scaler and ordinary-rest support
season-forward fitting; train-only median imputer and ordinary-rest support

featureRules.targetExclusion: Only completed games with game_date strictly earlier than target game_date enter a feature.
featureRules.sameDate: All target features for a calendar date are emitted before any result on that date updates history.
featureRules.possessions: Mean of both teams' FGA + 0.44*FTA - OREB + TOV estimates.
featureRules.pace: possessions * 48 / (48 + 5*overtime_periods), with overtime periods from the matched completed schedule.
featureRules.rebounds: OREB and DREB enter rates directly; source total_rebounds is retained separately and is not reconciled or used.
forms: current-season mean shrunk with 10 prior-season pseudo-games

jointDistribution.residuals: complete oriented home/away residual pairs from earlier chronological out-of-fold candidate predictions
jointDistribution.tieRule: existing NBA_GEN1_PAIRED_RESIDUAL_V1 empirical overtime-period rule using only earlier retained schedule line-score periods
jointDistribution.seedPolicy: existing SHA-256 game_seed with master seed 731001 and configuration identity

primaryMetric: joint energy score on the exact common game cohort
uncertainty: paired calendar-week block bootstrap, 2000 replicates, seed 731201; observed games are units, not simulation draws

advanceGate.stability: For each of 2025 and 2026, joint energy may not degrade more than 1 percent and team-score MAE may not worsen by more than 0.10 points.
advanceGate.integrity: All hard identity, box-component, chronology, distribution-accounting and reproduction checks pass.

ensemble: Not evaluated unless both standalone Gen2 candidates independently pass the frozen gate.
